title: MFA is enabled for the root user
detail: The root user has no MFA device
recommendation: Sign in as root and register an MFA device. This cannot be automated.

title: IAM password policy requires a minimum length of 14
detail: The password policy allows passwords as short as 8 characters; the baseline requires 14
recommendation: Set the account password policy minimum length to 14 or more.

title: MFA is enabled for all IAM users with a console password
detail: This user can sign in to the console without MFA
recommendation: Have the user register an MFA device, or remove their console password.

title: Access keys are rotated every 90 days or less
detail: This user's access key is 200 days old; the limit is 90
recommendation: Create a new access key, update the applications that use it, then deactivate the old key.

title: No IAM user has a full administrator policy attached directly
detail: This user has the full administrator policy attached directly
recommendation: Detach AdministratorAccess and grant only the permissions the user needs, through a group or role.

title: Hardware MFA is enabled for the root user
detail: The root user is not protected by a hardware MFA device
recommendation: Register a hardware MFA device for the root user.

title: S3 buckets block public access
detail: Block Public Access is off, so the bucket can be made public
recommendation: Turn on all four Block Public Access settings for the bucket.

title: S3 bucket policy denies requests that do not use HTTPS
detail: The bucket accepts unencrypted (HTTP) requests
recommendation: Add a bucket policy statement that denies requests where aws:SecureTransport is false.

title: S3 bucket versioning is enabled
detail: Versioning is off, so deleted or overwritten objects cannot be recovered
recommendation: Enable versioning on the bucket.

title: EBS encryption by default is enabled
detail: New disks are not encrypted by default
recommendation: Enable EBS encryption by default in the region.

title: EBS volumes attached to servers are encrypted
detail: The server has a disk that is not encrypted
recommendation: Snapshot the volume, copy the snapshot with encryption, and replace the volume in a downtime window.

title: MFA delete is enabled on S3 buckets
detail: MFA delete is off
recommendation: Enable MFA delete using the root user's credentials.

title: MFA delete is enabled on S3 buckets
detail: MFA delete is off
recommendation: Enable MFA delete using the root user's credentials.

title: MFA delete is enabled on S3 buckets
detail: MFA delete is off
recommendation: Enable MFA delete using the root user's credentials.

title: No security group allows SSH (port 22) from the internet
detail: Anyone on the internet can reach port 22
recommendation: Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rule for port 22 and use Systems Manager Session Manager or a restricted source range.

title: No security group allows RDP (port 3389) from the internet
detail: Anyone on the internet can reach port 3389
recommendation: Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rule for port 3389.

title: The default security group of every VPC restricts all traffic
detail: The default security group still has rules
recommendation: Remove all rules from the default security group and move resources to purpose-built groups.

title: No security group allows database ports (3306, 5432) from the internet
detail: Anyone on the internet can reach port 3306
recommendation: Remove the 0.0.0.0/0 rule and allow the database port only from the application tier.

title: CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
detail: The audit trail only covers one region
recommendation: Make the trail a multi-region trail.

title: CloudTrail log file validation is enabled
detail: Log file validation is off, so tampering with audit logs would go unnoticed
recommendation: Enable log file validation on the trail.

title: VPC flow logging is enabled
detail: Network flow logging is off
recommendation: Create a flow log for the VPC that captures rejected traffic at minimum.

title: S3 server access logging is enabled on buckets
detail: Access to the bucket is not being logged
recommendation: Enable server access logging to the central log bucket.

title: EC2 instances require IMDSv2
detail: The server still accepts the older, weaker metadata service (IMDSv1)
recommendation: Set the instance metadata option HttpTokens to required.

title: EC2 instances require IMDSv2
detail: The server still accepts the older, weaker metadata service (IMDSv1)
recommendation: Set the instance metadata option HttpTokens to required.

title: SSH root login is disabled
detail: Root can log in over SSH
recommendation: Set PermitRootLogin no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and reload sshd.

title: SSH password authentication is disabled
detail: SSH accepts passwords instead of keys only
recommendation: Set PasswordAuthentication no in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and reload sshd.
